Software Engineer I
Colorado Springs, CO, United States
TRENDING
JOB DESCRIPTION
The Software Engineer I participates in new and existing software developments. The role involves collaborating cross functionally to elicit requirements, design, build, test, deploy, and maintain software solutions.
RESPONSIBILITIES
Collaborate with business stakeholders and team members to understand product requirements and assist in translating them into software solutions
Analyze and document product processes, workflows, and system requirements
Design, develop, troubleshoot, and debug new and existing software solutions with guidance from experienced team members
Use approved AI-assisted development tools to support coding, testing, debugging, and documentation while reviewing and validating outputs for accuracy, security, and quality
Learn production systems, processes, and software applications to understand operational needs
Assist production teams with troubleshooting software issues, investigating root causes, and implementing software improvements with guidance from experienced team members
Identify and resolve system issues and bugs
Follow software development best practices to produce high-quality, maintainable code
Test and verify software modifications and final solutions
Document code and features developed, including changes to existing code
Demonstrate curiosity and a commitment to continuous learning by exploring new ideas and technologies, sharing knowledge, and contributing to the team’s growth and improvement
QUALIFICATIONS

Experience:

Bachelor's degree in Computer Engineering or Computer Science or Software Engineering
No experience is required. 
OR (4) years of experience may be considered in lieu of a Bachelors Degree.
ABOUT US
About Frontgrade
At Frontgrade, we build mission-critical electronics that perform without compromise in the world’s most demanding environments, from deep space to national defense. With decades of proven heritage, we deliver high-reliability components, subsystems, and integrated solutions trusted when failure is not an option. But our strength is not just in what we build. It is in the people who make it possible. From engineers and product managers to sales teams, marketers, and skilled manufacturing professionals, every role plays a direct part in enabling missions that protect, explore, and connect our world. We move with purpose, collaborate across disciplines, and take pride in delivering solutions our customers rely on in the highest-stakes environments. If you want your work, whatever your specialty, to contribute to something bigger, you will find your place at Frontgrade.
 
Why Work for Us
We believe mission success starts with taking care of our people. That’s why we offer competitive health, wealth, and wellbeing benefits from day one. You’ll also find real opportunities to learn, grow, and advance, whether you’re building technical expertise, leading teams, or expanding into new areas. Here, your growth is part of the mission.

Additional Information
This position may require access to technology, materials, software or hardware that is controlled by either ITAR or EAR U.S. export laws.  As a condition of any job offer, in order to be employed in this position, you may need to obtain a U.S. Government export license(s), as required by law.
 
Other benefits include:
Immediate Medical (FSA and HSA), Dental, and Vision
401K Match with 100% immediate vesting
9X80 compressed work schedule for qualifying roles
Career Opportunity and Growth
Tuition Reimbursement/Student Loan Repayment
Generous PTO and 11 paid Holidays per year (a combination of both designated and floating holidays)
8 weeks of 100% Paid Family Leave
